subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Should ClawSweeper become the sole protected-environment deployment authority for crawl-remote production under the coordinated cutover with https://github.com/openclaw/crawl-remote/pull/37?
rationale: Static review supports the defensive implementation, but only repository operators can authorize credential custody, protected-environment policy, activation order, and the operational contract that forward migrations remain applied during Worker rollback.

options.title: Approve supervised cutover
options.body: Merge while authority remains unset, coordinate the companion retirement, provision the protected environment, and run an operator-observed dormant rollout before enabling active states.

options.title: Require protected rehearsal
options.body: Keep the draft open until the intended environment proves reviewer policy, token scope, endpoint convergence, and rollback compatibility.

options.title: Retain service-owned deployment
options.body: Decline the transfer if crawl-remote should continue owning its production mutation workflow.

recommendation.title: Approve supervised cutover
recommendation.body: Merge while authority remains unset, coordinate the companion retirement, provision the protected environment, and run an operator-observed dormant rollout before enabling active states.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the broadest historical ownership of repository workflows and deployment-adjacent automation, making him the strongest available owner for this cross-repository authority decision.
